              Students will:
(1)Learn how the media design and technology are practically applied in our society and culture.
(2)Learn how to realize their dreams and ideal goals.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, visiting professors lecture on practical media applications. They are film directors, CM directors, anime producers, game producers, and so on. The specific members will be shown in the first class.
Students should seriously listen to the classes while taking notes.
